criteria.name: Product specificity
criteria.notes: Directly edits timeline, keyframes, and video frames; retention of precise commercial product assets across agent revisions is untested.

criteria.name: Output quality
criteria.notes: Uses standard video/canvas playback and FFmpeg export; rendering artifact rates under automated agent commands are unmeasured.

criteria.name: Control and consistency
criteria.notes: All agent edits are undoable and pass through typed transactional tool commands; multi-pass consistency requires verification.

criteria.name: Workflow strength
criteria.notes: Novel extension-based architecture and hot-reloading mod system; integration into commercial video workflows untested.

criteria.name: Speed and reliability
criteria.notes: Frame rendering and local agent response times dependent on local Apple Silicon hardware and Claude/Codex API latency.

criteria.name: Cost efficiency
criteria.notes: Desktop editor is 100% free and open-source; agent iterations consume the user's Claude Code or OpenAI API tokens.

criteria.name: Commercial rights
criteria.notes: GPL-3.0 license permits commercial video creation; distribution of modified extensions subject to GPL copyleft terms.

criteria.name: Automation and integration
criteria.notes: Agent hooks designed for interactive desktop usage; headless/batch automation capabilities undocumented.

criteria.name: Audience fit for AU SMBs
criteria.notes: Niche appeal: requires Apple Silicon Mac, terminal tooling (bun/Xcode), and developer AI subscriptions.

criteria.name: Monetization fit
criteria.notes: Zero affiliate program or commercial referral monetization for AIVP; editorial value only.
